version_note: 7.2.0 is the OpenAPI info.version; no data-release or row-revision field appeared in the source-list schema/selected response. Do not infer the API dataset release from the website download release.

sources.note: Served YAML despite .json URL; OpenAPI 3.1.0, API info.version 7.2.0.
Terms read via web tool. Climate TRACE data/associated metadata CC BY 4.0 with listed external-source exceptions. No refining-specific exception is listed on this page.
Owner search also returned four non-refining LUKOIL subsidiary names; selected exact parent-name result only.

sample_request.selection_note: Filtered owner and country/refining subset. The only documented list endpoint is ranked by emissions; raw metrics/order discarded immediately, projected rows sorted by source ID. This is neither a random nor representative national sample and establishes no complete national or owner coverage. year=2025 is the endpoint data parameter, not an operating-status date.
sample_request.response_hash_verification: SHA-256 computed over exact response bytes during retrieval before discarding raw payload. This artifact cannot replay that hash offline; a verifier would have to refetch the live URL, whose bytes/order/content may differ.
sample_request.projected_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON of records projected to id/name/country/sector/subsector/sourceType only, list sorted by numeric id; object keys sorted, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, no trailing newline.

licence.attribution: Source: Climate TRACE, https://climatetrace.org/; API retrieved 2026-10-19. Changes: retained identity/category fields only, sorted by source ID, added tentative local identity notes.
licence.exceptions_and_uncertainties: Terms list external dataset exceptions and separate ownership provenance. This pilot does not copy detailed ownership histories or third-party payloads. Refining is not an explicit exception on the terms page, but the RMI methodology/source chain and any package-specific notices have not been inspected; verify those before production redistribution.

schema_findings.response_shape: JSON array of models.SourceSummary, observed four objects
schema_findings.id: Observed integer internal source IDs. Documentation defines source identity using facility name, country, source type and subsector; do not treat as guaranteed permanent physical-facility UUIDs.
schema_findings.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, observed RUS. Preserve existing local territorial labels rather than overwriting with upstream boundaries.
schema_findings.source_type: All four observed sourceType values are point-source; not individual wells or oilfields.
schema_findings.local_category_mapping: oil-and-gas-refining -> refinery, subject to candidate evidence review.
schema_findings.missing_fields: No operating/reopening status, incident history, per-row revision, or verification date supplied by selected identity metadata.

integration_recommendation.decision: Tiny dependency-free read-only identity adapter, reusing the existing candidate/review gate. No adapter implemented in this assessment.
integration_recommendation.reason: Existing pipeline is a local review gate and has no Climate TRACE network wrapper. The observed API is a simple JSON array with six required identity/category fields; adding a framework or unrelated full wrapper would add unnecessary surface.
next_adapter_contract: Fetch documented definitions and a limited filtered source list; cache request URL, retrieval time, API schema version and exact response hash.
Immediately whitelist id/name/country/sector/subsector/sourceType; discard metrics and precise geography. Never use upstream ranking as project priority.
Use the documented /v7/sources/:id route for bounded follow-up refreshes after verifying current schema; those detail routes were not fetched in this pilot.
Store upstream source ID separately from local facility ID. Preserve current four local IDs and require exact identity evidence before binding crosswalks, especially Kstovo/Nizhny Novgorod.
New or changed facility snapshots must enter existing stage -> actual AI review -> approval -> export workflow; do not infer current operation or delete incidents from inventory metadata.
Cache inventories and upstream versions; avoid repeating national downloads every four hours.
limitations: No maintained third-party Climate TRACE SDK was evaluated; this recommends a tiny adapter relative to this repository, not a claim that no external wrapper exists.
Upstream source-list endpoint intrinsically returns metrics; projection must occur before persistence or display.

overlap_conclusion: Four potential existing-record crosswalks and zero new facilities proposed. Perm, Volgograd and Ukhta are strong name/operator matches for a later reviewed crosswalk. Hold the exact Kstovo/Nizhny Novgorod site binding until separate identity evidence resolves the existing local record scope.
